messages.content: Give me the price of a Tesla model S in India.

function.name: get_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieve the current exchange rate between two currencies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
Tesla has not officially launched the Model S in India yet, so there isn’t a published retail price in INR.  
If you’re curious about what it might cost, you can look at the U.S. price (roughly $90,000–$100,000) and convert it using the current USD‑INR exchange rate. For example, at an exchange rate of about ₹82 per USD, that would translate to roughly ₹7.4 crore–₹8.2 crore (₹740 million–₹820 million).  

Keep in mind that actual launch pricing would also include import duties, taxes, local production costs, and any adjustments Tesla might make for the Indian market.
